channel.title: Gaia's Secret Agents — Free Nature Missions
channel.description: Screen-free nature missions, environmental activities and printable field tools for children aged 6–11.

item.title: Free 5-Day Nature Tracker for Kids
item.description: Turn one tiny patch of your yard into a five-day nature investigation. Kids build a mini wildlife shelter, record clues and visitors, and practise real-world observation. Free 2-page printable for home, homeschool or classroom use.

item.title: 12 Screen-Free Ocean Activities for Kids Ages 6–11
item.description: Try rock-pool investigations, sound maps, simple current experiments and ocean-protection missions at the beach or at home. Low prep, useful and screen-free.
